name: project-memory
description: A version-controlled project context architecture for Claude Code and Codex. Keeps project memory accurate, minimal, retrievable, and evidence-backed across fresh sessions, context resets, branches, and worktrees. One skill with seven modes (init, status, sync, handoff, grill, audit, repair), a deterministic Node core, two lightweight hooks, a path-scoped writing rule, and an independent auditor that runs on an external model so memory is never graded by the context that wrote it.
